name: Guangzhou Toksen 3D Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Young (2024) Guangzhou filament brand TOKSEN3D selling budget PLA, high-speed PLA, transparent rainbow PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU and ASA via Amazon and Newegg. A supplier directory describes the company as a trading company, so it likely sources from an unidentified extruder.

oem_relationships.notes: Weak evidence: a supplier directory lists the company as a trading company founded 2024 rather than a factory. No extruder named anywhere.

additional_notes: Trademark filers per Justia: Guangzhou Toksen 3D Technology Co., Ltd. (logo mark, Oct 2024) and Guangzhou Tuosen 3D Technology Co., Ltd (word mark TOKSEN3D, Dec 2024), same Huadu District address; spellings Tuosen and Tosen 3D also appear on sourcing sites. No official website, docs or social accounts found. Budget tier unverified.

provenance.conflicts: Justia records read 2026-11-06: the word mark TOKSEN3D (serial 98883539, filed 2024-12-03, Class 17) is filed by 'Guangzhou Tuosen 3D Technology Co., Ltd' and the logo mark (serial 98780681, filed 2024-10-01, Class 17) by 'Guangzhou Toksen 3D Technology Co., Ltd.'; both at Building 16, No. 10 Xinhua Road, Huadu District, Guangzhou, so almost certainly one business under two romanisations (address evidence only). Trading-company description from a supplier directory not independently checked; manufacturing country unknown.
